newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Chilled Belgian kangaroo on the mend.
newsitem.headline: Chilled Belgian kangaroo on the mend.

text.p: A frostbitten kangaroo rescued earlier this month after spending two years on walkabout in woods near Antwerp is well on the mend and developing a healthy appetite, Antwerp zoo said on Thursday.
It said the Bennetts kangaroo, a native of Australia, could now stand on its own and was eating and drinking without any problems. No one knows where it came from.

There was no lasting damage from the frostbite to the ears and feet that nevertheless had not prevented the kangaroo putting up quite a struggle when police and firemen finally tracked it down in the middle of Belgium's big freeze.
Only one problem remains, the zoo said in a statement. No one can work out if the animal is male or female.
